## System Architectures & Projects
1. QuickLink — Enterprise Cloud-Native URL Shortener
   - Stack: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB Atlas, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes (AWS EKS), Jenkins, Prometheus, Grafana
   - Highlights: Deployed on managed Kubernetes with rolling updates, HPA (Horizontal Pod Autoscaling), and Grafana metrics dashboards.

2. Wanderlust — Full-Stack Vacation Rental Booking Platform
   - Stack: Node.js, Express, MongoDB, EJS / React, Mapbox GL, Cloudinary, AWS EC2
   - Highlights: Geo-spatial search using Mapbox coordinates, dynamic image transformation pipelines, automated GitHub Actions deployment.

3. WorkHive — Fair Labor Cooperative Marketplace
   - Stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS
   - Highlights: Multi-role authentication, KYC verification workflow, transparent fixed-rate payment settlement.

4. TradeX — Real-Time Stock Trading Simulation
   - Stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, WebSockets
   - Highlights: Atomic transaction isolation, sub-millisecond portfolio valuation, real-time candlestick charts.

5. CineBook — Movie Ticket Booking Platform
   - Stack: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Google OAuth 2.0
   - Highlights: Concurrency-safe seat locking mechanism preventing double-booking, encrypted QR ticket generator.
